skills.name: Composite - Measure with a measuring tool
skills.description: Use a measuring tool to measure a specific length of a piece of material

steps.activity: Position the measuring_tool on the object_to_measure or position the object_to_measure along the measuring_tool
Take measurement to determine the length of the object_to_measure

examples: Measure a pipe with a measuring tape

skills.name: Composite - Measure trueness with a level
skills.description: Use a level to check whether a surface is level, plumb, or otherwise aligned.

steps.activity: Position the level on the surface_to_check
Check the bubble in the level to determine if the surface_to_check is level

examples: Check if the top of a cabinet is horizontal with a spirit level

skills.name: Composite - Mark an object with a marking tool
skills.description: Use a marking tool to mark a specific location on a piece of material

steps.activity: Determine the location to mark on the object_to_mark
Position the marking_tool at the determined location on the object_to_mark
Mark the determined location on the object_to_mark with the marking_tool

examples: Mark a cutting line on lumber with a pencil

skills.name: Composite - Measure and mark something
skills.description: Use a measuring tool to mark a line or point on a piece of material

steps.activity: Measure the object_to_mark with the measuring_tool
steps.category: Composite - Measure with a measuring tool

steps.activity: Mark the measured location on the object_to_mark
steps.category: Composite - Mark an object with a marking tool

examples: Measure and mark a pipe to cut

skills.name: Composite - Mark with chalk line
skills.description: Use a chalk line to mark a straight line on a surface.

steps.activity: Position the chalk_line across the desired marking area on the surface_to_mark
Pull and release the chalk_line to mark a straight line on the surface_to_mark
steps.category: Pull or push an object with fingers

examples: Mark shingle guide lines on roofing felt with a chalk line

skills.name: Composite - Mark a vertical guide with a plumb bob
skills.description: Position a plumb bob and let it hang freely to establish a vertical guide on a surface.

steps.activity: Position the plumb_bob at the topmost point of the vertical guide on the surface_to_mark
Open fingers briefly to let the plumb_bob hang freely
Pinch the thread of the plumb_bob to stop it at the desired location

examples: Use a plumb bob to establish a vertical guide on a wall

skills.name: Composite - Locate and mark a stud position
skills.description: Probe a wall to locate a stud behind it and mark the stud position on the wall surface.

steps.activity: Push the probe into the wall_surface
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Determine the stud position based on the probe entrance and resistance
Mark the stud position on the wall_surface with the marking_tool

examples: Probe a foam-board wall with a nail to locate a stud and mark its position
